subject: Law
question: We, the people of India, having solemnly resolved to constitute India into a :
explanation: The Preamble of the Indian Constitution declares India as a Sovereign Socialist Secular Democratic Republic.

subject: Law
question: Provision for default bail is made :
explanation: Section 167(2) of the Cr.P.C., 1973 provides for default bail if the investigation is not completed within the stipulated time.

subject: Law
question: Fundamental Duties are given in :
explanation: Fundamental Duties are enshrined in Article 51A of the Indian Constitution.

subject: Law
question: Who appoints Attorney General of India ?
explanation: The Attorney General of India is appointed by the President of India.

subject: Law
question: Protection of life and personal liberty is :
explanation: Article 21 of the Indian Constitution guarantees the protection of life and personal liberty as a fundamental right.

subject: Law
question: Pleading means :

options.A: stating material facts and not evidence.
options.B: stating brief facts of the dispute.

explanation: Pleading means stating material facts and not evidence, as per Order VI Rule 2 of the CPC.

subject: Law
question: In which transfer, right to enjoy such property transfers ?
explanation: In a lease, the right to enjoy the property is transferred, while in sale, ownership is transferred.

subject: Law
question: As per Section 96 of the penal code, nothing is an offence which is done in the exercise of the :

options.D: power conferred by the state government

explanation: Section 96 of the Indian Penal Code states that nothing is an offence which is done in the exercise of the right of private defence.

subject: Law
question: Which of the proposition is correct ?

options.A: Every partner has a right to take part in the conduct of business.
options.B: Every partner is bound to attend diligently to his duties.
options.C: Every partner has a right to have access to inspect.

explanation: All the statements are correct regarding the rights and duties of partners under the Indian Partnership Act.

subject: Law
question: As per section 33 of the Maharashtra Rent Control Act, 1999 the jurisdiction of the court for the area of Brihan Mumbai is :

options.D: The Court in which the property is situated.

explanation: As per Section 33 of the Maharashtra Rent Control Act, 1999, the Court of Small Causes, Mumbai has jurisdiction for the area of Brihan Mumbai.

subject: Law
question: Which Court shall have power to issue directions in case of violation of fundamental rights ?
explanation: The High Court has the power to issue directions, orders, or writs for the enforcement of fundamental rights under Article 226.

subject: Law
question: Provision of common object is given in :
explanation: The provision of common object is given in Section 149 of the Indian Penal Code.

subject: Law
question: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by dangerous weapon is defined in :
explanation: Section 326 of the Indian Penal Code defines voluntarily causing grievous hurt by dangerous weapons or means.

subject: Law
question: Definition of mortgage is given in :

options.A: Section 57 of the Transfer of Property Act.
options.B: Section 58 of the Transfer of Property Act.
options.C: Section 59 of the Transfer of Property Act.
options.D: Section 60 of the Transfer of Property Act.

explanation: Section 58 of the Transfer of Property Act defines mortgage.

subject: Law
question: The provisions of penal code apply to any offence committed by :

options.A: any person in any place not within India.
options.B: person who is above twenty one years.
options.C: person who is above eighteen years.
options.D: any citizen of India in any place without and beyond India.

explanation: The Indian Penal Code applies to any citizen of India in any place without and beyond India.

subject: Law
question: Where, on a transfer of property, an interest therein is created in favour of a person to take effect only on the happening of a specified uncertain event is called :
explanation: Contingent interest is an interest created in favour of a person to take effect only on the happening of a specified uncertain event.

subject: Law
question: In which chapter of the penal code "General exceptions" are given ?
explanation: General exceptions are given in Chapter IV of the Indian Penal Code.

subject: Law
question: Where no provision is made by contract between the partners for the duration of their partnership, or for the determination of their partnership, the partnership is :
explanation: Where no provision is made by contract between the partners for the duration of their partnership, it is called a partnership at will.

subject: Law
question: Power to amend Constitution is with :
explanation: The Parliament has the power to amend the Constitution as per Article 368.

subject: Law
question: As per Article 121, an order to set aside an abatement is :
explanation: As per Article 121 of the Limitation Act, the period of limitation to set aside an abatement is ninety days.

subject: Law
question: The dying declaration is the statement by the person :

options.C: as to cause of his death.

explanation: A dying declaration is a statement made by a person as to the cause of his death or the circumstances of the transaction which resulted in his death.

subject: Law
question: Decree may be

options.A: prepared within one year of passing the judgement.
options.B: prepared at any time after passing the judgement.

explanation: A decree may be either preliminary or final.

subject: Law
question: Provision for determination of lease is given in :

options.A: Section 109 of the Transfer of Property Act.
options.B: Section 110 of the Transfer of Property Act.
options.C: Section 111 of the Transfer of Property Act.
options.D: Section 112 of the Transfer of Property Act.

explanation: Section 111 of the Transfer of Property Act provides for the determination of lease.

subject: Law
question: Out of the following propositions, which is correct one in respect of non-payment of fine ?

options.A: for any term not exceeding two months when the amount of fine shall not exceed fifty rupees.
options.B: for any term not exceeding two months when the amount of fine shall not exceed one hundred rupees.
options.C: for any term not exceeding two months when the amount of fine shall not exceed two hundred rupees.
options.D: for any term not exceeding two months when the amount of fine shall not exceed five hundred rupees.

explanation: As per Section 66 of the IPC, for non-payment of fine, the imprisonment shall not exceed two months when the fine does not exceed one hundred rupees.

subject: Law
question: "Evidence" means and includes :
explanation: Evidence means and includes both oral and documentary evidence.

subject: Law
question: First division of the schedule of period of limitation is prescribed for :
explanation: The first division of the schedule of the Limitation Act is prescribed for suits.

subject: Law
question: Concurrent list is given in :
explanation: The Concurrent List is given in Schedule VII of the Constitution.

subject: Law
question: In view of amendment in the year 2018, which of the following objects of the Specific Relief Act, 1963, has been amended ?

options.A: Grant of specific performance as an exception.
options.B: Grant of specific performance as a general rule.
options.C: Awarding damages as a general rule.

explanation: The 2018 amendment to the Specific Relief Act made specific performance a general rule rather than an exception.

subject: Law
question: By which calendar, rent shall be recovered ?

options.D: As per terms and condition of contract

explanation: As per the Maharashtra Rent Control Act, rent shall be recovered by the British calendar.

subject: Law
question: Judicial magistrate may arrest any person as per Section 44 of the Cr.P.C., 1973 :

options.A: when any offence is committed in the presence of a magistrate, within his local jurisdiction.
options.B: when any offence is committed in the presence of a magistrate, even beyond his local jurisdiction.
options.D: it is not the job of a magistrate.

explanation: As per Section 44 of the Cr.P.C., a magistrate may arrest a person when an offence is committed in his presence within his local jurisdiction.

subject: Law
question: Provision of arrest and detention is given in :
explanation: Section 55 of the CPC, 1908 provides for arrest and detention.

subject: Law
question: As per Section 29 of the Cr.P.C., 1973, the court of a magistrate of the first class may pass a sentence of imprisonment for a term not exceeding :
explanation: As per Section 29 of the Cr.P.C., 1973, a magistrate of the first class may pass a sentence of imprisonment for a term not exceeding three years.

subject: Law
question: The court may attach property of absconding accused under :
explanation: Section 83 of the Cr.P.C., 1973 provides for the attachment of property of an absconding accused.

subject: Law
question: Standard rent in relation to any premises means :
explanation: Standard rent means rent fixed as per the schedule under the Maharashtra Rent Control Act.

subject: Law
question: When sub- tenants can become tenants:

options.A: after determination of tenancy though it is sub-let illegally.
options.B: after completing a period of one year as sub-tenant.
options.C: after completing a period of two years as sub-tenant.
options.D: when the interest of a tenant of any premises is determined for any reason, any sub-tenant to whom the premises have been lawfully sub-let.

explanation: A sub-tenant can become a tenant when the interest of the original tenant is determined and the premises were lawfully sub-let.

subject: Law
question: Provision for substituted performance of contract is given in :

options.A: Section 18 of the Specific Relief Act.
options.B: Section 19 of the Specific Relief Act.
options.C: Section 20 of the Specific Relief Act.
options.D: Section 20-A of the Specific Relief Act.

explanation: Section 20-A of the Specific Relief Act provides for substituted performance of contract.

subject: Law
question: Under the provisions of Cr.P.C., 1973, every summons shall be served by a :
explanation: Under the Cr.P.C., 1973, every summons shall be served by a police officer or an officer of the court.

subject: Law
question: The provision for condonation of delay is given in :
explanation: Section 5 of the Limitation Act provides for the extension of prescribed period in certain cases (condonation of delay).

subject: Law
question: Order V Rule 20 of C.P.C., 1908 provides for :
explanation: Order V Rule 20 of the CPC, 1908 provides for substituted service.

subject: Law
question: "Documents" means any matter expressed or described upon any substance by means of :
explanation: Documents can be expressed by means of letters, figures, or marks.

subject: Law
question: Every transfer of immovable property made with intent to defeat or delay the creditors of the transferor is called :
explanation: A transfer made with intent to defeat or delay creditors is called a fraudulent transfer.

subject: Law
question: As per Article 65, period of limitation for possession of immovable property or any interest therein based on title is :
explanation: As per Article 65 of the Limitation Act, the period of limitation for possession of immovable property based on title is twelve years.

subject: Law
question: Magistrate of the first class may issue search warrant, if he has reason to believe that any person is confined under such circumstances that the confinement amounts to an offence :
explanation: Section 97 of the Cr.P.C., 1973 allows a magistrate to issue a search warrant for a person confined under circumstances amounting to an offence.

subject: Law
question: "Warrant Case" means :

options.A: a case relating to an offence punishable with death, imprisonment for life or imprisonment for a term exceeding two years.
options.B: a case relating to an offence punishable with death and life only.
options.C: a case relating to an offence punishable with an imprisonment for a term exceeding two years only.

explanation: A warrant case is one relating to an offence punishable with death, imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for a term exceeding two years.

subject: Law
question: Which court is called as court of record ?
explanation: The Supreme Court is a court of record.

subject: Law
question: Specific performance of a contract cannot be enforced in favour of a person :

options.A: who has obtained substituted performance of contract under section 20.
options.B: who has become capable of performing the contract.
options.C: who does not fail to prove that he has performed the essential terms of the contract.

explanation: Specific performance cannot be enforced in favour of a person who has obtained substituted performance of the contract.

subject: Law
question: The court may refuse to rescind the contract :

options.A: where the plaintiff has not ratified the contract
options.B: where third parties have not acquired rights in good faith
options.C: where only a part of the contract is sought to be rescinded and such part is not severable from the rest of contract

explanation: The court may refuse to rescind the contract where only a part is sought to be rescinded and it is not severable.

subject: Law
question: Mandatory injunction may be granted :

options.A: when it is not necessary to compel the performance
options.B: when no any acts are necessary to be performed
options.C: when to prevent the breach of an obligation, it is necessary to compel the performance of certain acts

explanation: A mandatory injunction may be granted when it is necessary to compel the performance of certain acts to prevent a breach of obligation.

subject: Law
question: The landlord shall be entitled to inspect the premises let or given on licence :

options.A: at after every interval of six months.
options.B: at a reasonable time after giving prior notice to the tenant.
options.C: at the beginning of lease agreement.
options.D: at the end of lease agreement.

explanation: The landlord is entitled to inspect the premises at a reasonable time after giving prior notice to the tenant.

subject: Law
question: Mesne profit shall not include :

options.A: profits due to improvements made by the person in wrongful possession.
options.B: profits due to improvements made by the person in legal possession.

explanation: Mesne profits do not include profits due to improvements made by the person in wrongful possession.

subject: Law
question: The plea of alibi is admissible :

options.A: as per section 9 of the Evidence Act.
options.B: as per section 10 of the Evidence Act.
options.C: as per section 11 of the Evidence Act.
options.D: as per section 12 of the Evidence Act.

explanation: The plea of alibi is admissible under Section 11 of the Evidence Act.

subject: Law
question: The provisions of the Maharashtra Rent Control Act, 1999 shall, in the first instance, apply to premises let for the purpose of residence, education, business, trade or storage in the areas specified in :

options.A: the notification issued by State of Maharashtra.
options.C: the order issued by State of Maharashtra.

explanation: The Act applies to premises in the areas specified in Schedule I and Schedule II.

subject: Law
question: Period of limitation for money payable for money lent as per Article 19 is :
explanation: The period of limitation for money payable for money lent is three years as per Article 19 of the Limitation Act.

subject: Law
question: Burden of proof means :

options.A: person who asserts, must prove that those facts exist.
options.B: person against whom allegations are levelled, must prove that those allegations are false.
options.C: person who has the evidence with him.

explanation: Burden of proof means that the person who asserts a fact must prove its existence.

subject: Law
question: Where a person in the town of Bombay, delivers to a creditor documents of title to immovable property, with intent to create a security thereon, the transaction is called :

options.D: mortgage by deposit of title deeds.

explanation: This transaction is called a mortgage by deposit of title deeds.

subject: Law
question: Principle of doctrine of eclipse is given in :

options.A: Article 13, Laws inconsistent with or in derogation of the fundamental rights.
options.C: Article 15, Prohibition of discrimination on ground of religion, race, caste, sex or place of birth.

explanation: The doctrine of eclipse is given in Article 13 of the Constitution.

subject: Law
question: Every agreement is restraint of the marriage of any person, other than a minor, is :
explanation: Every agreement in restraint of the marriage of any person, other than a minor, is void.

subject: Law
question: A instigates B to murder C. B refuses to do so :

options.A: A is not guilty of any offence.
options.B: A is guilty of attempt to commit murder.
options.C: A is guilty of abetting B to commit murder.

explanation: A is guilty of abetting B to commit murder, even if B refuses to do so.

subject: Law
question: Who gives oath to the Governor ?

options.C: Chief Justice of the High Court
options.D: Chief Justice of the Supreme Court

explanation: The Chief Justice of the High Court gives the oath to the Governor.

subject: Law
question: Which of the following proposition is correct ?

options.A: To disclose to the buyer any material defect in the property.
options.B: To produce to the buyer on his request for examination all documents of title relating to property.
options.C: To pay all public charges and rent accrued due in respect of the property upto the date of sale.

explanation: All the statements are correct regarding the duties of a seller under the Transfer of Property Act.

subject: Law
question: Res-gestae means :

options.A: facts in issue and relevant facts.
options.B: facts forming part of same transaction.

explanation: Res-gestae means facts forming part of the same transaction.

subject: Law
question: Provisions for execution of decrees and orders is given in :
explanation: Provisions for execution of decrees and orders are given in Order XXI of the CPC, 1908.

subject: Law
question: Defendant has to file his written statement within thirty days from :

options.A: the date of service of summons.
options.B: the date of his appearance in the court.
options.C: the date of signing of vakalatnama.

explanation: The defendant has to file the written statement within thirty days from the date of service of summons.

subject: Law
question: As per following section tenancy agreement to be compulsorily registered :

options.A: Section 52 of Maharashtra Rent Control Act.
options.B: Section 53 of Maharashtra Rent Control Act.
options.C: Section 54 of Maharashtra Rent Control Act.
options.D: Section 55 of Maharashtra Rent Control Act.

explanation: As per Section 54 of the Maharashtra Rent Control Act, tenancy agreements are to be compulsorily registered.

subject: Law
question: Whoever does anything with the intention of causing wrongful gain to one person or wrongful loss to another person, is said to do that thing :
explanation: Doing anything with the intention of causing wrongful gain or wrongful loss is defined as doing that thing dishonestly.

subject: Law
question: No injunction shall be granted by a court in a suit under Specific Relief Act, 1963 involving a contract relating to :
explanation: No injunction shall be granted in a suit involving a contract relating to an infrastructure project.

subject: Law
question: Under the provisions of sale of Goods Act, it is the duty of seller :

options.A: to accept and pay for them.

explanation: Under the Sale of Goods Act, it is the duty of the seller to deliver the goods.

subject: Law
question: No court shall try any suit or issue in which the matter directly and substantially in issue has been directly and substantially in issue in a former suit between the same parties is called :
explanation: The principle that a court shall not try a suit or issue already decided between the same parties is called res judicata.

subject: Law
question: Every person is competent to contract :

options.A: who is of the age of majority according to the law
options.C: who is not disqualified from contracting by any law

explanation: Every person is competent to contract if they are of the age of majority, of sound mind, and not disqualified by law.

subject: Law
question: Provision for burden of proving fact specially within knowledge is given in :
explanation: Section 106 of the Evidence Act provides for the burden of proving a fact specially within knowledge.

subject: Law
question: Court may issue a commission under Section 75 of C.P.C., 1908 :
explanation: A court may issue a commission for all the mentioned purposes under Section 75 of the CPC, 1908.

subject: Law
question: The provisions of the Maharashtra Rent Control Act, 1999 shall not apply :

options.C: to any premises belonging to the government

explanation: The Act does not apply to any premises belonging to the government.

subject: Law
question: Provision for who may obtain specific performance is given in :
explanation: Section 15 of the Specific Relief Act provides for who may obtain specific performance.

subject: Law
question: As per the statement of objects and reasons of the Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2018, it amended the law relating to :
explanation: The Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2018 amended the law relating to rape.

subject: Law
question: Principle of Estoppel is :
explanation: The principle of estoppel is a rule of equity.

subject: Law
question: The schedule for periods of limitation is divided in :
explanation: The schedule for periods of limitation is divided into three divisions.

subject: Law
question: A magistrate exercising jurisdiction in respect of a charge on which he has power only to commit for trial to another court, is :
explanation: A magistrate exercising such jurisdiction is not a judge.

subject: Law
question: The transfer of certain existing immovable property voluntarily and without consideration is called :
explanation: The transfer of certain existing immovable property voluntarily and without consideration is called a gift.

subject: Law
question: A lets a farm to B on condition that he shall walk a hundred miles in an hour :

options.A: The lease is voidable at the option of B.
options.D: The lease is neither valid nor void.

explanation: The lease is void as the condition is impossible to perform.

subject: Law
question: Which injunction may be granted to prevent the breach of an obligation existing in favour of person, whether expressly or by implication ?
explanation: A perpetual injunction may be granted to prevent the breach of an obligation existing in favour of a person.

subject: Law
question: A decree may be executed :

options.A: not by the court which passed it.
options.B: not by the court to which it is sent for execution.
options.C: either by the court which passed it or by the court to which it is sent for execution.

explanation: A decree may be executed either by the court which passed it or by the court to which it is sent for execution.

subject: Law
question: On the commencement of the Maharashtra Rent Control Act, 1999 the following laws shall stand repealed :

options.A: the Bombay Rents, Hotel and Lodging House Rates Control Act, 1947.
options.B: the Central Provinces and Berar Regulation of Letting of Accomodation Act, 1946.
options.C: the Hyderabad Houses (Rent, Eviction and Lease) Control Act, 1954.

explanation: All the mentioned laws were repealed on the commencement of the Maharashtra Rent Control Act, 1999.

subject: Law
question: Provision of section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963 applies to the :
explanation: Section 5 of the Limitation Act applies to appeals and applications.

subject: Law
question: A, a tradesman, leaves goods at B's house by mistake. B treats the goods as his own :

options.A: B is not bound to pay A for them.
options.B: B is bound to pay A for them.
options.C: B would say that goods are bad.

explanation: B is bound to pay A for them as he treated the goods as his own, which is a quasi-contractual obligation.

subject: Law
question: A stipulation in a contract of sale with reference to goods which are subject thereof may be a :
explanation: A stipulation in a contract of sale with reference to goods may be a warranty.

subject: Law
question: Public records kept in any state of private documents is :
explanation: Public records kept in any state of private documents are public documents.

subject: Law
question: Magistrate may record any confession or statement made to him in the course of an investigation :
explanation: Section 164 of the Cr.P.C., 1973 allows a magistrate to record confessions and statements in the course of an investigation.

subject: Law
question: When one person signifies to another his willingness to do or to abstain from doing anything, with a view to obtaining the assent of that other to such act or abstinence :

options.A: he is said to make a promise.
options.B: he is said to make a agreement.
options.C: he is said to make a proposal.

explanation: When one person signifies his willingness to do or abstain from doing something to obtain the assent of another, he is said to make a proposal.

subject: Law
question: No suit under Section 6 of the Specific Relief Act, 1963 shall be brought :

options.A: after the expiry of six months from the date of dispossession.
options.B: after the expiry of six months from the date of dispute between parties.
options.C: after the expiry of one year from the date of dispossession.

explanation: No suit under Section 6 of the Specific Relief Act shall be brought after the expiry of six months from the date of dispossession.

subject: Law
question: Period of limitation for twelve years for a landlord to recover possession from a tenant starts :

options.A: when the tenant refused to handover possession.
options.C: when the tenant stops to pay rent.

explanation: The period of limitation for a landlord to recover possession from a tenant starts when the tenancy is determined.

subject: Law
question: Cr.P.C., 1973 extends to :

options.A: the whole of India except state of Jammu and Kashmir

explanation: The Cr.P.C., 1973 extends to the whole of India.

subject: Law
question: Which of the following proposition is incorrect ?

options.A: Where the disability continues upto the death of that person, his legal representative may institute the suit within the same period after the death, as would otherwise have been allowed from the time so specified.
options.B: Where once time has begun to run, no subsequent disability or inability to institute a suit or make an application stops it.
options.C: In computing the period of limitation for any suit, the day from which such period is to be reckoned, shall not be excluded.
options.D: In computing the period of limitation for an application to set aside an award, the time requisite for obtaining a copy of award shall be excluded.

explanation: In computing the period of limitation, the day from which such period is to be reckoned is excluded, making statement (C) incorrect.

subject: Law
question: Consent is said to be free when it is not caused by :
explanation: Consent is said to be free when it is not caused by coercion, undue influence, fraud, misrepresentation, or mistake.

subject: Law
question: Any appeal may be admitted after the prescribed period, if the appellant satisfies the court that :

options.A: he is ready to pay additional court fee stamps.
options.B: he had sufficient cause for not preferring the appeal.

explanation: An appeal may be admitted after the prescribed period if the appellant satisfies the court that he had sufficient cause for not preferring the appeal.

subject: Law
question: When the person to whom the proposal is made signifies his assent thereto, the proposal is said to be accepted. A proposal, when accepted becomes a :
explanation: A proposal, when accepted, becomes a promise.

subject: Law
question: As given in section 53 of the Maharashtra Rent Control Act, 1999 the offences under the following section is cognizable :
explanation: As per Section 53 of the Maharashtra Rent Control Act, 1999, offences under Section 17 are cognizable.
